nodes.name: Webhook - Get Attributes
nodes.notes:
GET endpoint to retrieve all WooCommerce product attributes.
Returns a list of attributes (e.g., Color, Size) with their IDs.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - WooCommerce Attributes
nodes.notes:
Fetches all product attributes from WooCommerce.
Endpoint: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products/attributes
Returns an array of attribute objects.
